name: Sven Mikser - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Moldova
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on Moldova's progress towards joining the European Union. It praises Moldova's reforms and asks the EU to keep supporting the country with money, expert help and training. It calls for more EU money for Moldova's economy, energy and courts, and for help against Russian interference, especially before Moldova's elections in September 2025. The report does not change any laws itself; it sets out what the Parliament wants the EU and Moldova to do.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to give Moldova more money, support and expert help.
- **Who it affects:** People in Moldova, its government and courts, and EU taxpayers who fund the support.
- **What happens next:** The EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
